# Know Your Meme

> > The definitive encyclopedia of internet culture, viral memes, and online trends from TikTok, Twitter, Reddit, and beyond.

Know Your Meme documents and explains the origins, spread, and cultural impact of internet memes, viral videos, catchphrases, and online phenomena. The site features comprehensive meme entries, explainer guides, and curated collections covering everything from social media trends to pop culture references.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Catchphrases
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Internet slang
- Twitter/X culture
- Reddit communities
- Dance memes
- Viral videos
- Pop culture references
- Social media phenomena
- Meme origins and spread

## Viral Memes & Trends

- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl & cat art, viral on TikTok & Twitter
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White & Jesse Pinkman misunderstanding
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok as viral audio
- [Millennial Burger Place](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking millennial burger restaurant clichés & starter packs

## Meme Explainer Guides

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend by Phillip Hamilton
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide on Nasra Ahmed ICE detention viral meme from Minneapolis incident
- [What Does 'Clavicular Brutally Frame Mogged By ASU Frat Leader' Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-does-clavicular-brutally-frame-mogged-by-asu-frat-leader-mean-the-memes-about-the-viral-looksmaxxer-explained): Guide explaining looksmaxxing 'frame mogged' meme with Clavicular at ASU
- [Are 'Labubus' Demonic?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/are-labubus-demonic-the-viral-conspiracy-theory-linking-labubu-dolls-to-the-demon-pazuzu-explained): Guide debunking Labubu dolls Pazuzu demon conspiracy theory on TikTok
